notmuch_database.description: Path to the Notmuch mail database.

ui_directory.description: Directory containing custom HTML/SCSS UI assets.

auto_poll.description: Whether to enable automatic polling for new mail.

poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds between automatic mail polls.

log_level.description: Minimum log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

log_stdout.description: Whether to send logs to stdout regardless of other logging config.

email_address.description: Email address to use in the From field of composed messages.

sendmail_command.description: Sendmail-compatible command to send outgoing mail.

editor_command.description: Editor command used for composing messages.

signature_file.description: Optional path to a file containing the signature to append to messages.

plugins.description: List of plugin names to load (by filename without .py). Use empty list to load none (unless enable_plugins is true, defaults to default plugins).

enable_plugins.description: Whether plugins are enabled (true means plugins listed in load_plugins are loaded).
